messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | **ché** | causal conjunction “because” | **के कारण** | “because of” | OK | | **questa** | demonstrative “this” (modifying *bestia*) | **इस** | “this” | OK | | **bestia** | noun “beast” | **दानव** | “beast” | OK | | **per** | preposition “for” (introducing relative clause) | **के** | “for” | OK | | **la** | definite article (feminine singular) – not needed in Hindi | *(omitted)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **qual** | relative pronoun “which” (refers to *bestia*) | **जिसके** | “which” | OK | | **tu** | 2nd‑person pronoun “you” | **तुम** | “you” | OK | | **gride** | verb “you cry / shout” | **चिल्लाते हो** | “you cry” | OK | | **non** | negation “not” | **नहीं** | “not” | OK | | **lascia** | verb “allows / lets” (negated) | **देता** | “gives/lets” (with preceding नहीं) | OK | | **altrui** | indefinite pronoun “any other (person)” | **किसी** | “anyone” | OK | | **pasar** | infinitive “to pass” | **गुज़रने** | “to pass” | OK | | **per** (2nd) | preposition “through / along” | **से** | “through” | OK | | **la** (2nd) | definite article – not needed in Hindi | *(omitted)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **sua** | possessive adjective “its / his” | **अपनी** | “its/own” | OK | | **via** | noun “way / path” | **राह** | “way” | OK | | **ma** | coordinating conjunction “but” | **पर** | “but” | OK | | **tanto** | degree adverb “so much” | **इतना** | “so much” | OK | | **lo** | pronoun “him” (object) | **उसे** | “him” | OK | | **'mpedisce** | verb “hinders / blocks” | **रोकता** | “hinders” | OK | | **che** | complementizer “that” (introducing result clause) | **कि** | “that” | OK | | **l'uccide** | verb phrase “kills him” | **मार देता है** | “kills (him)” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: the Italian definite article **la** (appears twice) has no counterpart in Hindi and is therefore omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 94** - Original: इस दानव के कारण जिसके लिये तुम चिल्लाते हो, - Issue: none - Corrected: इस दानव के कारण जिसके लिये तुम चिल्लाते हो,
- **Line 95** - Original: वह किसी को भी अपनी राह से गुजरने नहीं देता, - Issue: none - Corrected: वह किसी को भी अपनी राह से गुजरने नहीं देता,
- **Line 96** - Original: पर वह उसे इतना रोकता है कि वह उसे मार देता है; - Issue: none - Corrected: पर वह उसे इतना रोकता है कि वह उसे मार देता है;
``` इस दानव के कारण जिसके लिये तुम चिल्लाते हो, वह किसी को भी अपनी राह से गुजरने नहीं देता, पर वह उसे इतना रोकता है कि वह उसे मार देता है; ```
